requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want my personal details (name, address, phone) stored, so that the system can uniquely identify me.

acceptance_criteria.text: Customer name, address and phone number are mandatory and stored as non-empty strings.
The system rejects creation of a customer record when any mandatory attribute is missing.
Given a valid customer input, When the customer is created, Then the record persists with the provided attributes.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to optionally add a single bank account, so that I can use it for payments.

acceptance_criteria.text: A customer may have zero or one bank account; attempts to add a second bank account are rejected.
Bank account data is stored encrypted at rest and in transit.
Given a customer without a bank account, When the customer adds a bank account, Then the account is linked to the customer.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to maintain product information (name, description, price, image), so that customers can view accurate product data.

acceptance_criteria.text: Product name, description, price and image are mandatory; price is a decimal number.
The system rejects creation of a product when any mandatory attribute is missing.
Given valid product data, When the product is saved, Then it is persisted and can be referenced by order items.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order that references existing products, includes at least one order item, and specifies a payment method, so that I can purchase items.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a known customer, at least one order item referencing existing products, and a valid payment method, When the order is submitted, Then the system creates an order with status submitted, order date set to the submission time, and total amount calculated as Σ(quantity × unit price).
Given an unknown customer, When the order is submitted, Then the system rejects the submission and no order is created.
Given an order with zero items, When the order is submitted, Then the system rejects the submission and no order is created.
Given an order item referencing a non-existent product, When the order is submitted, Then the system rejects the submission and no order is created.
Payment method on the order is restricted to bank, card, or cash.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to change an order’s status according to the allowed workflow, so that the order proceeds through the correct lifecycle.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with status submitted, When the staff receives the order, Then the status changes to pending.
Given an order with status submitted, When the staff attempts to receive it, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains submitted.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff marks it as filled, Then the status changes to filled.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff attempts to mark it as filled, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains pending.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff declines the order, Then the status changes to closed.
Given an order with status filled, When the staff ships the order, Then the status changes to shipped.
Given an order with status shipped whose invoice is not paid, When the staff attempts to close the order, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains shipped.
Order status may only transition as follows: submitted → pending → filled → shipped → closed; or submitted → pending → closed.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to raise a single invoice for a filled or shipped order, so that the customer can be billed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a filled or shipped order without an existing invoice, When the accountant raises an invoice, Then an invoice is created with status issued, the supplied date, amount, and payment method.
Given an order that already has an invoice, When the accountant attempts to raise another invoice, Then the system rejects the request.
Given an order with status submitted, pending or closed, When the accountant attempts to raise an invoice, Then the system rejects the request.
Payment method on an invoice is limited to bank, card, or cash.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit a payment against an issued invoice, so that I can settle my bill.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice with status issued, When the customer submits a payment with a valid payment method, Then a payment record is created with status pending.
Given an invoice with status paid, When the customer attempts to submit a payment, Then the system rejects the request.
Given an invoice whose previous payment has status failed, When the customer submits a new payment, Then the new payment is created with status pending and the failed payment remains failed.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to confirm or reject a pending payment, so that the invoice status reflects the payment outcome.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment with status pending, When the accountant confirms it, Then the payment status becomes completed and the related invoice status changes to paid.
Given a payment with status pending, When the accountant rejects it, Then the payment status becomes failed and the invoice and order statuses remain unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to confirm or reject it, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains unchanged.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to close a shipped order whose invoice is paid, so that the order lifecycle ends.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a shipped order whose associated invoice has status paid, When the staff closes the order, Then the order status becomes closed.
Given a shipped order whose invoice is not paid, When the staff attempts to close the order, Then the system rejects the request and the order status remains shipped.
Once an order reaches status closed, no further status changes are allowed.

requirements.statement: As the system, I want to enforce data‑integrity rules (mandatory attributes, multiplicities, decimal types, enumerated values), so that the data remains consistent.

acceptance_criteria.text: All monetary values (product price, unit price, order total, invoice amount, payment amount) are stored as decimal numbers.
Order status is restricted to the enum values submitted, pending, filled, shipped, closed.
Invoice status is restricted to issued or paid.
Payment status is restricted to pending, completed, or failed.
Payment method on orders, invoices and payments is limited to bank, card, or cash.

requirements.statement: When a user submits an order containing up to 50 order items under normal operating conditions, the system shall register the order and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions.
Under normal operating conditions, the system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second while meeting the response time of NFR‑01.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The system shall protect customer personal data and bank account numbers by encrypting them in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain these records for at least 12 months.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
When a server failure occurs, the system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.
